_comment: Tier-3 (mocked cheap-LLM + mocked-embedding) corpus for the fold-time episode pass (v4 runFoldEpisodePass, lib/memory/fold-episode-pass.ts). The COMPLETION call is pinned by recording the exact (provider|model|temperature|messages) key the oracle answered and replaying it through CannedCompletionProvider on the Rust side — so a prompt-byte divergence surfaces as a canned-miss. The EMBEDDING call is pinned by exact buildMemoryEmbeddingText text, as in the memory-gate corpus. Two runs: `episode_pass` (a narrative-timeline window with two present characters, one absent participant, and per-character fragment memories to link) and `no_episodes` (the model returns [] — the pass must write nothing). P4.144 adds three LOG-LINE runs (each over a NEW chat with TWO present characters, Aria + Bram): `episode_fail` (the completion THROWS — v4's `[FoldEpisodePass] Episode extraction failed` WARN), `episode_write_fail` (a BEFORE INSERT trigger plant aborts Aria's episode — `Failed to write episode for character` for Aria, Bram's written, then `Episode pass complete`), and `episode_link_fail` (a BEFORE UPDATE trigger plant aborts Aria's episode LINK update — v4's catch sits outside both link loops, so Aria's window fragments are NOT back-linked). The plants live in `plants` and are created by the builder in the /tmp pair only. A third plant fails Bram's fragment BACK-link in `episode_link_fail`, so both link-write sites reach the catch.
_safety: testPepperBase64 is the same THROWAWAY key the other fixtures use — never a real pepper.

characters.comment: P4.D212 (bug 161): created as 'Dell' through v4's REAL repo, then blanked to name '' by a direct UPDATE. Pre-fix, both v4's private loop (`if (character)`) and v5's pushed the EMPTY name and rendered ': …'; the shared resolver's `if (character?.name)` gate drops it, so the line renders 'Character: …'. Its seat is ABSENT in the outing chat, so the pass writes it no memory; the line sits in `episode_pass`'s window, where a prompt-key miss changes the written episodes (in `no_episodes` a miss and a hit both write nothing, so the arm would be invisible there).

plants.comment: P4.144: v4's INSERT path is `create` THEN an `updateForCharacter({ embedding })` (memory-service.ts:595-606), so a trigger on content + character alone fires INSIDE the gate (measured: memoriesWritten 1, the create-path arm again).
